about_the_game:
Welcome to Darseki High School. You’re not supposed to be here.

In Metits Magic 3: The Revenge of Luli, you step into the dark, twisted corridors of a once-familiar school, now haunted by terrifying secrets. This survival horror adventure will push your mind, reflexes, and courage to their limit.

🧬 Uncover the Truth

After a mysterious disappearance, you wake up inside the Alon Building with one goal: find out what really happened to the Sacred Protein. But you’re not alone.
The halls echo with the footsteps of Big Marina, the school's terrifying principal, now patrolling the corridors with a mind of her own. Stay low. Move fast. Don’t let her see you.

💀 Face the Faculty from Hell

The teachers you once trusted are now monsters:

  • Jaffa Mirror: A corrupted language teacher stalking you through Class Y1.

  • Gariela & Rachel: Twin forces of biblical horror—Gariela uses scripture to summon her sister from beyond.

  • Costa: The electronics teacher who controls both fire and lightning in an unforgettable boss fight.

  • Luli: He was just a quiet kid. Now, he’s your worst nightmare. His rage is the final obstacle between you and the truth.

Metits Magic 3: The Revenge of Luli

Some memories don’t stay buried. Are you ready to face them?
